page.layout: One printed page. Top: woodcut ornament border. Then a full-width title block in large roman capitals and roman type, then a full-width italic dedication line block, then body text in one column with a decorated initial, notes in the right margin, and a page number line at the foot. Left margin contains handwritten/marginal pencil-like marks and a vertical side annotation (not transcribed as text). Top right has a handwritten scribble (not transcribed).

main_text.head: REVERENDISSIMIS, ILLUSTRIBUS, GENEROSIS, ET NOBILISSIMIS IN CHRISTO PATRIBUS AC Dominis: DN. PRÆPOSITO: DN. DECANO & vniuerso CAPITULO Summæ Ædis sacræ, Ecclesiæ Cathedralis, siue Metropolitanæ, apud S. ARCHIEPISCOPALEM Sedem Moguntinam: Dominis suis Clementissimis, & PATRONIS omni debitorum obsequiorum cultu submissæ venerandis.
GRATIAM, PACEM AC MISERICORDIAM

p.i: à Deo, Patre, per DN. NOSTRVM IESVM CHRISTVM, in communione Spiritus sancti, ex hoc nunc & in perpetuum.

main_text.p: ECulum est, Reuerendissimi Patres, Clementissimi Domini, PATRONI gratiosissimi, seculum, inquam, est & Viuificatur fides, exspirat Charitas. quod excurrit, ex quo volantibus vexillis, infestis armis, & dubio Marte concursum ac depugnatum hactenus est de Fide iustitia, & eius forma, causis, effectis, &c. Neque adhuc cantatur receptui; quod quam recte quamve secus factum sit, fiatve, arbitrum me modo constituere, aut amplius etiam disceptare instituti mei prorsus non est, hoc saltem liceat mihi bona scientia & conscientia affirmare ac deplorare, eo rem esse redactam, ut dum de fide digladiamur, & hostilibus admodum armis utrinque decernimus, Diuæ Charitatis & Theoriam & praxin fere in totum obsoleuisse, & hunc Ecclesiastici coeli phosfera amabilissimum iamplurimos annos miserandam Ecclypsin pati, idque in omnibus omnino Hierarchiis, ordinibusve sacris, nullo omnino excepto, neque arbitror, quen quam bonum atque cordatum esse, qui hoc non agnoscat, apudque animum suum mecum deploret, nedum ut inficias ire possit: adeo plane incidi-

page.notes: Right margin notes "Viuificatur" and "fides, exspirat Charitas." placed beside the first paragraph. Left margin has faint handwritten annotations, not transcribed. Several words in the body are uncertain due to the scan's faint print and show-through; the first word "ECulum" is likely "SECULUM" with decorated initial S. The top-right and top-left handwritten marks are excluded.
